articles.summary: GLP-1 medications work in large part by curbing appetite, and for many patients that's exactly the point. But appetite suppression is a blunt instrument: it makes weight loss possible, while also making it easy to under-eat, miss key nutrients, and lose muscle alongside fat. Side effects like nausea are common, especially in the early months, and represent one of the most frequent reasons people stop taking these medications altogether. For most patients, navigating all of these dynamics falls entirely on them.
articles.title: Maximizing GLP-1 Impact: Real-World Results from Nourish Patients
